items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember -- did you ever hear Bessie Smith work? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: And trumpet players, and clarinet players and musicians accompanying Bessie Smith or Ma Rainey or whoever, they were just a part of what was happening. I don't see how they could say they resented them. Well, of course they were doing their thing.
Maybe they were a little jealous, too.
